title: FieldLink Synthetic Operational Summary

claims.statement: Synthetic data shows 900 raw source rows, 840 accepted requests, and 60 rejected requests.
The rejection rate is 6.66666667%, and the rejected request count is 60.
Accepted requests total 840, and affected units total 21,015.
Resolved requests total 588, and the resolution rate is 70.00000000%.
Median resolution time is 18.00 hours, and the within-target rate is 75.00000000%.

limitations.text: Data is synthetic and represents no real organization, person, or result.
The report covers only the fixed June-August 2026 demonstration period.
Rejected records are excluded from operational indicators and reported separately.
Patterns do not establish causes; operational follow-up is required.
Service targets are fictional project rules, not employer commitments.

follow_up_checks: Review unresolved requests for the 252 recorded cases.
